release_read.basis: FY2026 Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA guide raised to $10.0-10.3bn from $8.7-9.1bn (midpoint +$1.25bn, ~14%), well beyond what the TTF proxy alone implied, with diluted EPS $0.96 against Nasdaq's $0.50 forecast and 99% of 2026 cargos contracted; sized at about the 8.1% option-implied move, below the +14/+17% of past clean beats because the August raise was sold.

release.headline: Venture Global Q3 2026: revenue $4.8bn, net income $2.5bn, Adjusted EBITDA $2.6bn; FY2026 EBITDA guide raised to $10.0-10.3bn

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast in the brief (fallback, 7 estimates)

key_line.detail: Raised to $10.0-10.3bn from $8.7-9.1bn, assuming a $21-22/MMBtu fee on remaining unsold 2026 cargos (old assumption $12.50-13.50); cargo range tightened to 509-518 from 500-518. Plaquemines Phase 1 COD 31 Oct; CP2 first LNG mid-2027; 2.0 MTPA new 20-year SPAs.

guidance.detail: FY EBITDA $10.0-10.3bn vs prior $8.7-9.1bn; street consensus for the FY guide not found in time.

call.detail: Call started 09:00 ET and is in progress during this review; content not read. The pre-market high came before it and the price sagged into it, so the call may already be weighing.

public_reaction.summary: No time to search for analyst actions or retail tone before compile; the only press item found (RTTNews 'trims full-year outlook, stock up in pre-market') is from November 2025, not this release.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 12.18 (+3.22%) against prev close 11.80; pre-market ran to 12.86 (+9.0%, about the implied move and my release read) and has sagged back, last print 12.02 at 09:17, 189 prints, 27 in the last 30 min, not stale. Market weak (SPY -0.5%, QQQ -1.0%). Pre-market holds about a third of what the release supports.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a FY EBITDA guide raise on unsold cargos priced far below TTF; the raise came and was larger than the judges' proxy suggested.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market (27 prints in 30 min) argues the open holds the ~3% shown, but the run-up-then-sag during the 09:00 call raises the chance the open slips below half; the gap is small against the release and bmo names keep repricing, so fade by 10:00 is below the usual earnings-gap rate.

recommendation.limit_basis: Just under the pre-market high of 12.86, about +8.9% on prev close: roughly the option-implied move and the frozen release read; reachable if the session reprices the guide raise, otherwise the position goes at the close.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de stelling ruim: de jaarprognose voor EBITDA gaat van 8,7-9,1 naar 10,0-10,3 miljard dollar en de winst per aandeel is bijna het dubbele van de verwachting, maar de voorbeurs staat maar zo'n 3% hoger. Zet een verkooplimiet op 12,85 (de voorbeurstop); wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de koers voor 09:30 onder het slot van gisteren (11,80) door negatieve signalen uit de lopende call, verkoop dan bij de opening.
